description: A minimal PRD used to verify that docs/plan/ralph.sh can select one task, make a small change, verify it, update this PRD, append progress, and stop cleanly.
testSafety: This PRD is for local Ralph workflow testing only.
Do not modify backend, frontend, migrations, deployment files, secrets, or product behavior.
Only touch docs/ralph-smoke-test.md plus the Ralph bookkeeping files referenced by the script.

tasks.title: Create Ralph smoke test handoff note

acceptanceCriteria: The file contains the heading '# Ralph Smoke Test'

This PRD task is updated with completion status and verification evidence

verification: Confirm the required heading and handoff section are present
Confirm git diff only includes the smoke test document and Ralph bookkeeping files
tasks.evidence: Created docs/ralph-smoke-test.md with heading, handoff note, and confirmation that no production code was changed. All acceptance criteria verified 2026-07-07.
